# A-Discord vendor note: HOI4 Flag Maker

This directory is an opaque copy of the Windows GUI released as
[atthematyo/hoi4_flag_maker](https://github.com/atthematyo/hoi4_flag_maker).
The vendor's retained `README.txt` identifies it as Version 1.1.0 by John
Edward Love. It is a manual flag-authoring utility, not part of the A-Discord
validator or generator command surface; no wrapper or compatibility command is
provided.

## Provenance and licence material

The complete 990-file, 35,710,782-byte bundle was moved byte-for-byte from
`tools/hoi4_flag_maker_gui/`. The upstream README is retained unchanged. The
bundle also retains its included Tcl/Tk licence at
`_internal/tk/license.terms` and its accompanying image README. No project
licence was added or inferred for the executable or its bundled runtime.

## Update policy

Do not patch files below this directory. To update it, obtain a release from
the upstream project, review its licence and every bundled dependency, record
the new version and source here, and replace the bundle as a single reviewed
vendor update. Keep the original README and bundled licence notices. The
repository contract rejects a return of this bundle below `tools/`.
